title: The status header shows a fixed score denominator ('score0/366') from turn 1, and I hit the cap exactly ('score366/366') around turn 523 — with only 3 of 6 hold-hollows rested and Coldpass, Hollowbrook, the Iron Downs, and all of Marrowgate still completely unvisited.
